Q961.reason: The statutory violation establishes negligence per se because the driver was within the class of motorists the statute was designed to protect.

Q901.reason: The materials were nondefective when supplied, and the independent installer’s negligence does not establish manufacturer liability.

Q983.reason: Graves disease can produce a diffuse goitre, historically included under the term Derbyshire neck, but not a large multinodular goitre.
